data:
NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 results show flat sales but sharply lower profitability. Revenue was $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023, compared with $26.9 billion in fiscal 2022, growth of just 0.2%. Gross profit fell to $15.4 billion in fiscal 2023 from $17.5 billion in fiscal 2022, leaving a fiscal 2023 gross margin of 56.9%. Operating income declined to $4.2 billion in fiscal 2023 from $10.0 billion in fiscal 2022, for a fiscal 2023 operating margin of 15.7%. Part of the pressure came from heavier investment: R&D expense rose to $7.3 billion in fiscal 2023 from $5.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income dropped 55.2% to $4.4 billion in fiscal 2023 from $9.8 billion in fiscal 2022. We view the elevated R&D spend as a deliberate bet on future growth. Investors will want evidence that it can restore margins.

Note: I left diluted EPS out of the note because the fact sheet's figures don't reconcile. Fiscal 2022 EPS of $3.85 on $9.8 billion of net income implies a share count that would put fiscal 2023 EPS far above $0.17 on $4.4 billion of net income. Please confirm the correct fiscal 2023 EPS, or whether the two years use different share bases, such as before and after a stock split, and I'll add it.
